evidence.title: Read independently authorized Govern Response Result in existing Command Incident Detail
evidence.goal: Complete a bounded Class-0 Govern→Command Result consumption in existing authenticated Incident Detail without mutating Incident, Run, Decision or Result. Shared owner authorizes Incident→Result relation and Govern owner independently checks perm.govern.result.read before provenance/outcome/residual risk are displayed.
outputs: The existing local Incident Detail now displays bounded Govern-authorized Result outcome, verification, residual risk, provenance and referenced Run ID
Source with denied Govern result is omitted without ID/count; absent provider yields explicitly partial Result unavailable state
Go handler tests for authorized/dropped Results, malicious identities, failures, revoked Incident, plus real localhost multi-principal HTTP browser tests
acceptance_tests: Visible incident and authorized Shared relation and Govern Result.read render Result ID, Run ID, lifecycle, outcome, verification, residual risk and source version; host escape prevents HTML injection
Readable Incident to commander without Govern grant renders no Result or ID, even if Shared relation exists; exact lookup is per-result
Malformed/refused/foreign/duplicated/too-many references or poisoned Result record abort whole output before HTML, while missing/denied individual Result is omitted
Legacy handler without optional sources keeps existing Incident/Alert/Case HTML and explicit partial unavailable state
Go runtime tests, race, vet, cross-platform host and engineering/security mandatory checks pass on exact candidate SHA

rules: Strict tenant isolation and permission checking
